points.description: States the term "water application efficiency" (efficiency of water application), i.e. names the efficiency as applying to water application in the field, using the technical term precisely.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the answer says "application efficiency" or "irrigation application efficiency" without the word "water" but is clearly the same term; otherwise 0.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) only for "efficiency of water application" / "water application efficiency". Give 1 mark only for the close form "application efficiency" (or "field application efficiency"). Other efficiencies (conveyance, storage, distribution, use, irrigation efficiency generally) or unrelated answers earn 0.
